candidates.file: File:Snow Billowing into Stadium at the Coldest Notre Dame Game in 22 Years, Notre Dame Stadium, University of Notre Dame, South Bend, Indiana (11051657934).jpg
candidates.artist: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA
candidates.description: Notre Dame Stadium is the home football stadium for the University of Notre Dame Fighting Irish football team. Located on the southeast part of the university's campus in Notre Dame, Indiana and with a seating capacity of 80,795, Notre Dame Stadium is one of the most renowned venues in college football. The Sporting News ranks Notre Dame Stadium as # 2 on its list of "College Football Cathedrals".
categories: BYU Cougars at Notre Dame Fighting Irish football (November 23, 2013)

candidates.description: Indiana Hoosiers punt returner Lester Kun (right, number 43) runs downfield for a 42 yard return during the second quarter of their game against the USC Trojans on October 2, 1953 at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum in Los Angeles, California. Trojans players George Bozanic (background right, number 38) and Leon Sellers (foreground right, number 44) close in on Kun.
